quotes.summary_phrase: Detroit's bench performance was the deciding factor in the game
quotes.excerpt: their bench was the difference tonight. I mean you look at the box score, number of guys scoring
quotes.quote: I mean wish we had built on that lead that we had in the first quarter. Their bench was the difference tonight. I mean you look at the box score, number of guys scoring, playing well. They brought the pop, they brought the level of physicality that changed the game.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins says the Detroit bench was the difference tonight, noting they brought the pop and physicality that changed the game.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins discusses how the Detroit bench performance impacted the game outcome during his postgame press conference.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Joe's impact and defensive lapses
quotes.excerpt: Isaiah Joe was a big focal point and we let him get too many easy looks.
quotes.quote: Obviously Isaiah Joe was a big focal point and we let him get too many easy looks. So disappointing there. There was good moments for sure, but that third quarter definitely got away from us. We missed some shots, they got a rhythm, a little game plan discipline.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins admits the team let Isaiah Joe get too many easy looks tonight, calling the defensive lapses disappointing.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins addresses defensive lapses against Isaiah Joe during his postgame press conference.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins

quotes.excerpt: I thought Thompson started adjusting to what we were trying to do to him.
quotes.quote: I thought Thompson started adjusting to what we were trying to do to him. But it was the bench for Detroit that was the game changer today.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins on the defensive game plan against Thompson: I thought he started adjusting to what we were trying to do to him.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Bennedict Mathurin's aggressive play and need for better ball movement
quotes.excerpt: he's been seen a lot of pressure, picking his spots to be aggressive, scoring and trying to playmake
quotes.quote: I liked how he was playing. I mean obviously he's been seen a lot of pressure, picking his spots to be aggressive, scoring and trying to playmake at the same time. This is the adjustment that he's got to endure. Overall, I thought he was great when he was getting downhill. Obviously, we got to do a better job moving the ball as a team at times. He's going to have a responsibility in that as well. They're picking up pressure on him at half court, how do we get into our offense a little bit cleaner? But when he got into his space, I thought he was doing some good things.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins on Bennedict Mathurin: I liked how he was playing. He is seeing a lot of pressure and has to learn how to get us into our offense a little bit cleaner.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins evaluates the performance and playmaking adjustments of Bennedict Mathurin during his postgame press conference.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Team execution and ball movement in the first half
quotes.excerpt: we were executing our game plan. I thought we had really good ball movement.
quotes.quote: We were executing our game plan. I thought we had really good ball movement. Obviously got off to a good start, their bench came in and got back to a tighter game. We withstood some runs and were able to have a lead in halftime, but it just kind of fell apart there in the third quarter.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins says the game fell apart in the third quarter after a strong start where the team was executing the game plan and moving the ball well.
